name: Lam Vien Square
summary: Walk out onto Lam Vien, the paved square on the edge of Xuan Huong Lake, for the open view across the water. It is a 30-minute stroll on an ordinary day and the stage for the flower festival in December 2026.
getThere: Walk from Xuan Huong Lake to Tran Quoc Toan
heroCaption: The flower hall and the lake at Lam Vien Square

notice.title: The festival show is two nights
notice.body: The opening is at 20:00 on 19 December 2026 and the closing, with the New Year programme, at 20:00 on 31 December 2026. On other evenings the square is a quiet stroll.

body: The square sits on Tran Quoc Toan, where the lake edge opens into a paved stage. An ordinary visit is a 30-minute stroll, and entry is free.

In December 2026 the square is also the festival stage. The flower festival opens here at 20:00 on 19 December 2026 and closes, with the New Year programme, at 20:00 on 31 December 2026. Flower displays run about 18 December 2026 to 3 January 2027 around the lake.

figures.caption: The square building by the lake
figures.alt: Building on Lam Vien Square beside Xuan Huong Lake

gettingThere: Walk along the Xuan Huong shore to Tran Quoc Toan. The square is on the lake.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Walk along the shore to the square.

admissionNote: Free. 2026 festival show tickets are Check on arrival.
